tools.name: create_strategy
tools.description: First call for a new brief: the marketing direction (positioning, target insight, 3 personas tied to the 3 variant codes you plan, message pillars, tone, channels, launch phases relative to launch day, KPIs, risks, next steps). Boards and videos must follow it. Unknown numbers stay as [placeholders].

tools.name: update_strategy
tools.description: Change part of the marketing strategy. Send only the paths that change, e.g. pillars/1/message or phases/0/end_day.

tools.name: create_card_boards
tools.description: Create a complete card concept: concept, palette, typography and three distinct variants with design points. Use for a new brief or a completely new direction. The result is validated; fix any returned errors and call again.

tools.name: update_card_boards
tools.description: Change part of the current card concept. Send only the paths that change, e.g. variants/1/material/tint or palette/1/hex. Other fields stay as they are.

reason.description: One line: what the customer asked for

path.description: Slash path into card_boards, list items by index

tools.name: create_storyboard
tools.description: Create one video storyboard (reels, youtube or promo) for the current card concept. One call per video. It plays immediately as a live preview in the customer's page; it is NOT rendered to MP4 until render_video. Scenes must tile the whole duration and end with stack_lockup.

tools.name: update_storyboard
tools.description: Change part of an existing storyboard: timing, captions, scene order or params.

tools.name: render_video
tools.description: Render the final MP4 of one storyboard. Call ONLY after the customer has watched the live preview and clearly approved it (e.g. '이대로 확정', 'MP4로 뽑아줘'). Never call it right after creating or editing a storyboard.

approval_quote.description: The customer's own words approving the render
